observation: No affordance to add a media file from the local device (no file picker, no Browse/Upload button). Media intake is drag-and-drop only.
reportedBy: owner (observed in own browser during sign-off run)
agentVerification: confirmed independently in code + live app
codeEvidence: src/ui/shell/Workbench.tsx:450-483 — DropZone: onDrop handler + 'Drop a video or audio file to begin' + 'Try a sample clip' button; no click-to-pick path
src/ui/shell/Workbench.tsx:983-995 — DropZone mount (currentProject === null); sample path is intake.loadSample() (bundled clip, failure code SAMPLE_FAILED), not a picker
src/ui/shell/Workbench.tsx:1041-1043 — the ONLY <input type="file"> in the UI is translation-file-input (accept .srt/.vtt/.ass/.ssa)
src/ui/shell/Workbench.tsx:365 — Media-tab empty state copy is drop-only: 'No media loaded. Drop a video or audio file to begin.'
src/ui/shell/ProjectList.tsx:225-234 — 'New project' only creates an empty row; media still arrives by drop
src/app/context.ts:477 — persistenceDeps.openFilePicker() exists but is reachable ONLY from the media relink keep/replace flow (fingerprint mismatch), never as an add-media entry point
impact: drag-and-drop is the sole local-media path — undiscoverable for pointer users who do not try dragging, and impossible via keyboard/assistive paths; likely also blocks touch/pen-only use (app targets desktop browsers ≥ 1280×720)
classification: product deficiency — candidate backlog seed; proposed for unit-200 design review (CC-200.x) and product.md backlog
